reasons.claim: Eligible VU lichen Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav; forest-associated, site-bound, threats include lack of continuity forest and large/old trees) has 18 records, nearest 873 m from the polygon, recent (2026) and low uncertainty (10-25 m). None within 250 m, so MEDIUM under the rubric.
No records inside the polygon or within 250 m; near-site effort there is also zero records, versus a county median of 3 within 250 m, so this absence says little.
Completed fellings overlap only 2.6% of the polygon, so it is not already felled.
NT moss Crossocalyx hellerianus recorded at about 909 m; NT, so it is supporting only.
Notification is a regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) of 3.83 ha polygon.

uncertainties: The nearby records are 873 m or more away; they do not show the species occupies this stand.
Near-site recording appears nil, so the stand's own content is unknown.
The 1000 m effort (73 records, about the county median) is adequate, but it does not show that the stand itself was surveyed.
not_established: Presence or absence of red-listed species within the polygon.
Forest stand age or quality; no tool output describes it.
Whether felling would affect the species recorded nearby.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for old-forest and lichen habitat, for example by field inventory or aerial imagery, before the felling start date, and consider whether the nearby Alectoria sarmentosa cluster extends toward the polygon.
